monopoly.name: monopoly
notes: Original generic green house, red hotel, property card and six-sided die represent Monopoly play. Building bases touch the card; die rests on the same external support plane. Opposite die faces sum to seven. No complete board, trademark lettering, exact edition proportions or supplied component promise.

studio-recording.name: studio-recording
notes: Original microphone assembly follows the broad capsule, side-pivot yoke and circular supported foot visible in the Logitech Yeti product photograph. It is not an exact Yeti model or an assertion about the library equipment. The lower body clears the yoke bottom by25mm. Recording dot and waveform in the icon are flat semantic overlays, not floating physical parts.

party-cruise.name: party-cruise
notes: Original generic two-level passenger vessel uses joined hull/deck/cabin geometry and a forward pilothouse with open upper passenger area. Circle Line Manhattan-class photograph is a construction reference only, not the event vessel. Window panels lie on cabin surfaces; rail posts terminate at the upper deck. Underwater hull is deliberately schematic and no stability, capacity, access or exact deck-count promise is made. Musical notes and waves are flat semantic overlays.
